```yaml
name: Release Precompiled Binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Tag to release (e.g., v1.2.3)'
        required: false

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}
      tag_name: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get tag name
        id: get_tag
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            echo "tag_name=${{ github.event.inputs.tag }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "tag_name=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Validate tag matches Cargo.toml
        run: |
          TAG_VERSION="${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag_name }}"
          TAG_VERSION=${TAG_VERSION#v}
          CARGO_VERSION=$(grep -E "^version\s*=" Cargo.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)
          if [[ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$CARGO_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Tag version ($TAG_VERSION) does not match Cargo.toml version ($CARGO_VERSION)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag_name }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false

  build-cli:
    needs: create-release
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Linux x86_64
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            features: ""
            cuda: ""
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            features: "cuda-11-8"
            cuda: "11.8"
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            features: "cuda-12-4"
            cuda: "12.4"
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            features: "cuda-13-0"
            cuda: "13.0"
          # Linux aarch64
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            features: ""
            cuda: ""
          # macOS arm64
          - target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
            features: "metal"
            cuda: ""
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install lld
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install CUDA Toolkit
        if: matrix.cuda != ""
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.0
        with:
          cuda: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
          method: network

      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu'
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Build CLI
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" ]]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features "${{ matrix.features }}"
          else
            RUSTC_WRAPPER="" cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features "${{ matrix.features }}"
          fi
        env:
          RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""

      - name: Package artifacts
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" ]]; then
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake dist/
          elif [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-apple-darwin" ]]; then
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake dist/
          else
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake dist/
          fi
          cd dist
          tar -czf cake-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz cake
          sha256sum cake-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz > cake-${{ matrix.target }}.sha256
        env:
          RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cli-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/*

  build-mobile:
    needs: create-release
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Android aarch64
          - target: aarch64-linux-android
            os: ubuntu-latest
            features: ""
            platform: android
          # iOS arm64
          - target: aarch64-apple-ios
            os: macos-latest
            features: "metal"
            platform: ios
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.platform == 'android'
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Install Android NDK
        if: matrix.platform == 'android'
        uses: nttld/setup-ndk@v1
        with:
          ndk-version: r25b
          add-to-path: true

      - name: Build Mobile Library
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ matrix.platform }}" == "android" ]]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features "${{ matrix.features }}" --lib
          else
            RUSTC_WRAPPER="" cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features "${{ matrix.features }}" --lib
          fi
        env:
          RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""

      - name: Package artifacts
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          if [[ "${{ matrix.platform }}" == "android" ]]; then
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/libcake_mobile.so dist/
          else
            cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/libcake_mobile.a dist/
          fi
          cd dist
          tar -czf cake-mobile-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz libcake_mobile.*
          sha256sum cake-mobile-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz > cake-mobile-${{ matrix.target }}.sha256
        env:
          RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mobile-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/*

  publish-release:
    needs: [create-release, build-cli, build-mobile]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: List downloaded artifacts
        run: find artifacts -type f

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.release_id }}
          asset_path: ./artifacts/cli-*/cake-*.tar.gz
          asset_name: cake-*.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.release_id }}
          asset_path: ./artifacts/cli-*/cake-*.sha256
          asset_name: cake-*.sha256
          asset_content_type: text/plain

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.release_id }}
          asset_path: ./artifacts/mobile-*/cake-mobile-*.tar.gz
          asset_name: cake-mobile-*.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.release_id }}
          asset_path: ./artifacts/mobile-*/cake-mobile-*.sha256
          asset_name: cake-mobile-*.sha256
          asset_content_type: text/plain

      - name: Publish release
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            github.rest.repos.updateRelease({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              release_id: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.release_id }},
              draft: false
            })
```
